Default.//comment: For production, point Path at your PFX and set Password (or use a secret store / env var). For local dev leave these blank and run 'dotnet dev-certs https --trust' to use the ASP.NET dev certificate.

ManagerTool.//AgentVersion: Version the server advertises as the latest agent (must match the installer's version so the dashboard shows the right 'latest' and rollouts aren't reported as no-ops).

Retention.//comment: Activity events are deleted after 'Days'. Set Days to 0 to keep indefinitely. 'SweepHours' is how often the purge runs (also purges recordings).

Recording.//comment: On-disk session recording. 'Directory' is where recorded sessions are written (relative to the app base unless absolute). 'RetentionDays' deletes old sessions; 0 keeps them indefinitely.

Notifications.//comment: Outbound alert delivery. Empty by default = nothing sends. MinSeverity: info|warning|critical. Fill in only the channels you want.

Admins.//comment: Generate with: dotnet run --project src/ManagerTool.Server -- hash-password "yourpassword"
